evidence: Has the Wallet label and modifies `src/wallet/rpc/encrypt.cpp` to deprecate encrypting existing wallets.
rationale: Deprecates a hazardous workflow where encrypting existing wallets can invalidate backups, leave plaintext keys on disk, or unexpectedly alter descriptor spending conditions (#26607). Phasing out post-creation wallet encryption addresses long-standing fund safety risks and unblocks full removal (RFC #36027).
